{{TierBar}}

'''Walking Heads''' are a tier of parasites comprised of the severed heads of [[Assimilated Mobs]]. In terms of hierarchy, they can be considered the same tier as their [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated]] counterparts.

Walking Heads are generally non-threatening but can be difficult to hit and tend to be fought in groups.

==''Shared Aspects and Capabilities''==

===Spawning===
*Spawn with a 50% chance after an [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mob]]<ref>Excluding the [[Assimilated Bear]] and the [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref> dies.
*Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

===Weakness===
*Like all Parasites, Walking Heads present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).

===Capabilities===
*Walking Heads inflict the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effect when attacking.
*Walking Heads can perform small leaps at a target.
*Walking Heads<ref>Except for the Walking Ender Dragon Head.</ref>, can fuse with [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to evolve back into their full counterparts.
*Walking Heads<ref>Except for the Walking Ender Dragon and Enderman Heads.</ref> will run away when there are no other parasites nearby.
*Walking Heads are capable of performing small leaps in liquids which grants them a movement advantage.
**Walking Heads are capable of jumping a certain amount of blocks, depending on the mob, in order to reach their targets.
